title: 47 hook entries cut to 7
rationale: component-impact.md found zero positive effect across 4,347 transcripts and 07-hook-effectiveness found zero exit-2 blocks in 103 transcripts. Survivors: codemap-inject, northstar-protect x2, irreversible-pause, bash-write-fence, claude-spawn-gate, harness-usage-telemetry. Rollback: cp ~/.claude/settings.json.bak-2026-08-10.

title: graphify stays; the AST codemap did not replace it
rationale: graphify 0.8.47 is installed and ran 84 times on 2026-08-11 with graphs regenerated same-day in three repos. codemap looks unused only because codemap-inject injects it at SessionStart rather than being invoked. They answer different questions: codemap what exists, graphify what reaches what.

description: A VERIFY step demanding grep -c return 0 for deleted hook names made a builder delete the honest what-was-removed section. Same class as bash-write-fence blocking a command because a quoted string contained a write pattern.
resolution: Verify meaning, not substring presence: assert the section exists and the hooks are unregistered, not that a word is absent.

title: Secrets blocked by permission deny rules, not a hook
rationale: Rung 3 of the ponytail ladder: native platform enforcement beats a new hook script. Verified in fresh headless sessions - .env and .env.local BLOCKED, .env.example readable, *.pem blocked via both Read tool and Bash. Rollback: cp ~/.claude/settings.json.bak-canary-2026-08-11 ~/.claude/settings.json

description: Allow-listing Read(**/.env.example) did NOT rescue it from a broad Read(**/.env.*) deny rule - the fresh-session probe returned BLOCKED
resolution: Deny always wins in Claude Code and there is no negation syntax. Enumerate the risky variants instead of denying a wildcard and carving exceptions.

title: Lightweight harness plan favors adaptation over new machinery
rationale: Existing SHA-drift codemap refresh, Graphify, Mulch, and decomposition cover the workflow; the largest opportunity is deleting duplicated instructions and unused MCP/skill exposure.
